title: Invoicing and Credit Control Schedule: Office Pantry & Beverage Program
content:
Payment terms, late charge figures and the credit hold point for the Office Pantry & Beverage Program are printed against the tier the programme is held at.

| Tier | Payment due from the invoice date (calendar days) | Monthly late charge on an overdue invoice, as a percentage of the overdue amount | Calendar days past the due date before a late charge may be raised | Ceiling on the late charge against one invoice (USD) | Days past due at which standing deliveries stop |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 15 | 1.50 | 3 | 120.00 | 45 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 21 | 1.50 | 5 | 280.00 | 60 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 30 | 1.25 | 7 | 700.00 | 75 |
| Barista Bar Program | 30 | 1.25 | 7 | 1450.00 | 75 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 45 | 1.00 | 10 | 2500.00 | 90 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 45 | 0.90 | 14 | 5200.00 | 120 |

## The five figures as this schedule states them

1. The payment figure is the number of calendar days from the invoice date within which payment is due.
2. The late charge percentage is a monthly charge on an overdue pantry invoice, expressed as a percentage of the overdue amount.
3. The grace figure is the number of calendar days past the due date before a late charge may be raised.
4. The ceiling is the largest late charge that may stand against one pantry invoice, in United States dollars.
5. The credit hold figure is the number of days past due at which standing deliveries stop.

## Reading the schedule across the range

Two tiers may share a payment term while differing on everything else in the line: Full Hospitality Pantry Program and Campus Pantry Network Program are both due 45 calendar days from the invoice date, yet carry late charge percentages of 1.00 and 0.90, grace periods of 10 and 14 calendar days, ceilings of 2500.00 and 5200.00, and credit hold points of 90 and 120 days past due. Fresh Pantry Program and Barista Bar Program agree on every figure in this schedule except the ceiling, which stands at 700.00 and 1450.00.
